description: vCISO client questionnaire covering all management-system clauses (4-10) and all Annex A controls (93). One question per clause/sub-clause/control.

scoring_model.logic: Each question's selected option carries a 'status'. Roll up per clause/control: PASS if 'yes', PARTIAL if 'partial', FAIL if 'no', N/A if 'na' (excluded from scoring, requires justification). Overall theme/domain score = (sum of scores of answered, non-N/A questions) / (2 * count of answered, non-N/A questions) * 100.
